primary_evidence: LSO-GOV-2022 says Lesotho has ten administrative districts; 2022 delimitation instrument establishes electoral constituencies and separates convenience district maps; UN SALB identifies a national-validated district layer updated 2024-06-24.
source_crosswalk: Name corresponds to one of the ten administrative districts. Atlas child and immediate parent have the same district name; that duplicated tier is not established by the cited Lesotho administrative/electoral sources.
source_license: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0
uncertainty: 2017 OSM-derived source polygon is not legal/current-boundary proof.
Official district polygon source geometry is not retained because SALB terms restrict commercial use and geometry alteration; contributor consent is not documented.
Current community-council boundary tier remains outside the retained polygons; sources report 124 councils (2022 report) and 128 (older decentralization material), with no dated reconciliation here.

disposition: Preserve both IDs and geometry. Engineering should determine whether the repeated parent is a structural duplicate, alternate feature role or intentional mapping convention using hierarchy provenance; no deletion/reparenting is authorized by this research packet.
